summary: A revised set of ARPANET mailing lists for distributing network documents, replacing the one in RFC 329. List A lets sites reach network liaisons quickly with their own documents, while lists B and C are used by the Network Information Center for other participants and for station agents. It was replaced by RFC 402.

eli5.summary: An updated address book of who should get printed copies of network notes, so every person on the list gets their mail.
